```yaml
name: Docker Build and Test for Browser Mode

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, beta, release]
    paths:
      - Dockerfile.browser
      - src/**
      - test/**
      - package.json
      - yarn.lock
      - tsconfig.json
      - events/**
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 1,15 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      mosquitto:
        image: eclipse-mosquitto:2.0
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "mosquitto -c /mosquitto-no-auth.conf"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.browser
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }}
            ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-latest
          outputs: type=image,name=ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer,annotation-index=0

      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v1
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          push-to-registry: true

      - name: Report image size
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq
          echo "Image digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          echo "Image size per platform:"
          docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-latest | jq -r '.manifests[] | "\(.platform.architecture) \(.size)"'

      - name: Run integration tests
        env:
          MQTT_BROKER_HOST: mosquitto
          MQTT_BROKER_PORT: 1883
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y curl
          # Start the application container
          docker run -d --name mqtt-explorer \
            -p 8080:8080 \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_HOST=$MQTT_BROKER_HOST \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_PORT=$MQTT_BROKER_PORT \
            ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-latest
          # Wait for health check
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/health | grep -q "200"; then
              echo "Health check passed"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          # Run UI tests
          yarn test:browser
          # Stop and remove container
          docker stop mqtt-explorer
          docker rm mqtt-explorer
```
